description: This file defines the HomeViewModel class for managing the UI state related to the home screen in an Android application. It handles loading data via a repository, managing loading, success, and error states, and exposes LiveData for the UI to observe.

classes.name: HomeViewModel
classes.description: A ViewModel class managing the UI state for the home screen, including data loading and error handling.

classes.name: HomeState
classes.description: A sealed interface representing the different states of the home screen: loading, data loaded, and error.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Initiates loading of home data from the repository, updating the LiveData state accordingly.
